purpose: Freeze the exact identity of the v3 member-manifest normalization (request-generated member exclusion) before the v3 harvest runs, so the reproducibility gate it will be judged against is fixed by governance and not by outcomes. Answers the required-next-step recorded by workflowhub-member-manifest-freeze-v1/RESULT_V1.json: a new frozen normalization decision with its own preflight, its own durable snapshot, and any successor-frame rebind left to separate freeze governance.

normalization_identity.rule: normalized member manifest = frozen v2 normalized_content_manifest minus entries whose canonical path is exactly ro-crate-metadata.json or ro-crate-preview.html at the crate root; aggregate = the frozen v2 canonical_json_sha over the retained entries
normalization_identity.exclusion_scope: uniform for every crate of every family of the frozen 128-family successor frame; root canonical path only; nested members sharing a basename are retained
structural_requirements_retained_verbati: exactly one root ro-crate-metadata.json per crate
canonical member-path validation (no absolute paths, no '..'/'.' segments, no backslashes)
path-sorted entries and canonical JSON SHA-256 aggregate

execution_contract.run_location: LUNARC batch nodes (egress to workflowhub.eu verified by sbatch 3569314)
execution_contract.fetch_independence_requirement: at least 3 independent fetches per family per version; gate is byte-identical v3 aggregates AND identical retained and excluded member path sets across every fetch of every family and version
fail_closed_rules: any family failing the per-version reproducibility gate fails the whole harvest with terminal CANNOT_CHECK_MEMBER_MANIFEST_V3_REPRODUCIBILITY and the exact failing partition, emitting no chunks
any family whose before and after v3 aggregates are equal fails the harvest closed as a descriptor-only change inadmissible under the frozen frame's content-differ rule
v2 aggregates are computed per fetch as cross-check evidence only and never gate the harvest
execution_contract.expected_outcome_recorded_before_executi: 128/128 families reproducible if the exclusion rule captures the whole volatility mechanism; this expectation is checked against, not assumed, and a non-green outcome is reported as found

gives_up_recorded: descriptor-only version-pair changes are indistinguishable from no content change and fail closed instead of materializing
frozen v2 aggregates cease to be the live substrate binding; a separately governed successor-frame rebind is required before any downstream frame admission changes
registry-side crate-descriptor drift (rendering, metadata-only edits) is invisible to v3 content identity
ro-crate-preview.html content is not bound at all; only its presence is recorded
the per-request bytes of the generated members are declared out of scope rather than pinned
downstream_contract_delta: the candidate-visible record contract's normalization_source line in A3_CANDIDATE_POLICY_FREEZE_V1.json is superseded for substrate materialization by this freeze; the candidate policy executable, decision rule, premise mechanics and free-parameter-freeness are untouched; amending A3_CANDIDATE_POLICY_FREEZE_V1.json itself is reserved to freeze governance and is not performed by this lane
